vocab.simpleEn: to treat something as more important
vocab.simpleZh: 把某件事放在更重要的位置。
vocab.exampleEn: Students should prioritise accuracy before trying to use complex vocabulary.
vocab.exampleZh: 学生应该先重视准确性，再尝试复杂词汇。
vocab.upgradeEn: Use prioritise when giving advice or discussing choices.
vocab.upgradeZh: 给建议或讨论选择时可以用 prioritise。

cycle.summaryEn: Build clean sentences with the right tense, articles, and clause control.
cycle.summaryZh: 把时态、冠词和从句控制好，句子更稳。

frame.useEn: Use to show your opinion clearly.

meaningEn: This writing word helps Becky build stronger IELTS paragraphs and ideas.
meaningZh: 这个写作词可以帮助 Becky 写出更强的雅思段落和观点。
promptEn: China drill: read the Chinese meaning, shadow the example twice, then make one Becky-style sentence with "prioritise" using In my view, ...
promptZh: 中文母语者练法：先看中文意思，跟读例句两遍，再用 "prioritise" 和 在我看来，... 写一句 Becky 自己的话。
sourceEn: This harder word is auto-picked for Becky and refreshes every day with a China-friendly output drill.
sourceZh: 这个高分词会每天自动为 Becky 刷新，并配中文母语者适用的输出练习。
